e: Health minister Atonio Lalabalavu declares a national HIV emergency after the government confirms that one in 60 adults is living with the virus.
The Fijian and Australian governments sign two bilateral defence and economic treaties in Suva.
Police confirm that over 60 parcels containing cocaine had washed up on beaches at various locations including the Lau Islands, Munia Island, Kadavu Island and Qamea over the past week.
Israel reopens an embassy in Suva for the first time in 30 years.
Bainimarama and Qiliho plead not guilty to charges of inciting mutiny against Fiji Military Forces commander Kalouniwai.
Former prime minister Frank Bainimarama and former police commissioner Sitiveni Qiliho are arrested on charges of inciting mutiny against Fiji Military Forces commander Jone Kalouniwai in 2023.
